facts.fact: Adwave lets users top up their prepaid wallet anywhere from $30 to $50,000.
facts.quote: Top up anywhere from $30 to $50,000 whenever you like, set a daily budget between $30 and $10,000, and pause anytime.

facts.fact: Adwave lets users set a daily campaign budget between $30 and $10,000.
facts.quote: set a daily budget between $30 and $10,000, and pause anytime.

facts.fact: Adwave does not use subscriptions or contracts; it uses a prepaid wallet where each live campaign charges its daily budget.
facts.quote: Adwave doesn't do subscriptions or contracts. You prepay into a wallet, and each live campaign charges its daily budget, which is a ceiling

facts.fact: Campaigns pause when the Adwave wallet runs dry.
facts.quote: Campaigns pause when the wallet runs dry, so you can never go into debt.

facts.fact: Adwave's autopilot tunes audiences and the funnel hourly.
facts.quote: It tunes audiences and the funnel hourly, budgets, creatives, and bids daily, the channel mix weekly, and it runs a holdout readout monthly

facts.fact: Adwave's autopilot adjusts budgets, creatives, and bids daily and the channel mix weekly.
facts.quote: budgets, creatives, and bids daily, the channel mix weekly

facts.fact: Adwave runs a holdout readout monthly to show incremental lift.
facts.quote: it runs a holdout readout monthly so you can see the lift that's incremental

facts.fact: Adwave advertises across Meta, Google (YouTube and Search), Reddit, TikTok, web, mobile, and television from a single daily budget.
facts.quote: buys the media across Meta, Google, Reddit, TikTok, web, mobile, and television, and keeps improving from your own site data, all under one daily budget.

facts.fact: Business campaign creative made in the Adwave app, chat edits, and landing pages are included in pricing, while optional extra creation and API or MCP generation carry separate charges.
facts.quote: Business campaign creative made in the app, chat edits, and landing pages are included. Optional extra creation and API or MCP generation have separate charges.

facts.fact: Adwave states it does not guarantee ROAS, leads, or sales.
facts.quote: Adwave does not guarantee ROAS, leads, or sales.

facts.fact: Adwave's self-described ad-tracking uses one site tag with guided installs for Shopify and WooCommerce and server-side webhooks for Stripe and Zapier.
facts.quote: One tag (SPA-aware, with guided installs for Shopify and WooCommerce, plus server-side webhooks for Stripe, Zapier, or your own backend)

facts.fact: Adwave's signup is passwordless, requiring only a website URL and an email address.
facts.quote: Signup is passwordless: give it a website URL and an email, and we send a one-time code.

facts.fact: Adwave states that business campaigns start at $30 per day from a prepaid wallet.
facts.quote: Business campaigns start at $30/day from a prepaid wallet, with no monthly business subscription.

facts.fact: Adwave states that there is no monthly business subscription for its business campaigns.
facts.quote: with no monthly business subscription. Agency licenses are separate.

facts.fact: Adwave states that agency licenses are priced separately from business campaigns.
Adwave states that the autopilot runs a monthly holdout to show incremental lift.
facts.quote: the autopilot runs a monthly holdout to show incremental lift.

facts.fact: Adwave states that ROAS and CPA are derived from the advertiser's own site data.
facts.quote: Your ROAS and CPA come from your own site data

facts.fact: Adwave states it guarantees the process rather than the outcome, and does not promise a specific ROAS.
facts.quote: It guarantees the process, not the outcome.

facts.fact: Adwave states that guided installs are offered for Shopify and WooCommerce, with server-side webhooks for Stripe, Zapier, or a custom backend.
facts.quote: guided installs for Shopify and WooCommerce and server-side webhooks for Stripe, Zapier, or a custom backend.
